attribute_alignment.instructions: Which verdict does this grocery-listing attribute evidence carry? Judge only what the state says; answer with one label.

criteria.aligned: the state's package, volume, flavour and brand evidence describe one consistent grocery listing
criteria.mismatched: the state carries contradictory values for one and the same attribute (e.g. two volumes, conflicting pack types)
criteria.obscure: the state carries too little attribute evidence to align either way

identity_claim.instructions: Does the paired attribute evidence support the two rows carrying the same grocery item (same physical product, not merely the same brand or category)? Answer true only when the evidence supports the identity claim.

package_state.instructions: Does the state carry explicit package-quantity evidence (a pack count or a unit volume)?

field_same:volume.instructions: Do the two listings' measured volume values agree? Judge only the v1=/v2= volume evidence in the state.

criteria.same: volume is measured on both sides and the values are identical
criteria.different: volume is measured on both sides and the values disagree
criteria.unknown: at least one side leaves volume unmeasured

field_same:pack.instructions: Do the two listings' measured pack-count values agree? Judge only the v1=/v2= pack evidence in the state.

criteria.same: pack is measured on both sides and the values are identical
criteria.different: pack is measured on both sides and the values disagree
criteria.unknown: at least one side leaves pack unmeasured

field_same:package_type.instructions: Do the two listings' measured package types agree? Judge only the v1=/v2= package_type evidence in the state.

criteria.same: package type is measured on both sides and the values are identical
criteria.different: package type is measured on both sides and the values disagree
criteria.unknown: at least one side leaves package type unmeasured

field_same:sweetener.instructions: Do the two listings' measured sweetener values agree? Judge only the v1=/v2= sweetener evidence in the state.

criteria.same: sweetener is measured on both sides and the values are identical
criteria.different: sweetener is measured on both sides and the values disagree
criteria.unknown: at least one side leaves sweetener unmeasured

field_same:flavor.instructions: Do the two listings' measured flavours agree? Judge only the v1=/v2= flavor evidence in the state.

criteria.same: flavour is measured on both sides and the values are identical
criteria.different: flavour is measured on both sides and the values disagree
criteria.unknown: at least one side leaves flavour unmeasured

field_same:carbonation.instructions: Do the two listings' measured carbonation values agree? Judge only the v1=/v2= carbonation evidence in the state.

criteria.same: carbonation is measured on both sides and the values are identical
criteria.different: carbonation is measured on both sides and the values disagree
criteria.unknown: at least one side leaves carbonation unmeasured

pack_volume_equal.instructions: Do the two listings carry the same package quantity (the same measured unit volume and the same measured pack count)?

pack_format_equivalent.instructions: Do the two listings carry the same package format (the same measured pack type / container form)?

gate_verdict.instructions: What verdict did the identity gate reach on this pair? Judge only the state; answer with the gate decision.

criteria.proceed: the gate let the pair through (compatible critical attributes)
criteria.hard_no: the gate blocked the pair (a decisive identity conflict)
criteria.fallback: the gate could not decide and fell back to adjudication

gate_reason.instructions: Which gate-reason family did this pair belong to? Judge only the state; answer with one family.

criteria.pack_blocker: a pack size, package type or volume mismatch blocked the pair
criteria.critical_attribute: a critical attribute (flavour, sweetener, pulp, ...) mismatched
criteria.contradictory_evidence: the source attribute evidence was contradictory
criteria.declared_identity_incomplete: the declared product identity differed or was incomplete
criteria.missing_flavor_evidence: flavour evidence was missing while supporting attributes differed
criteria.low_volume_confidence: raw volume evidence was too weak to trust
criteria.low_pack_confidence: raw pack evidence was too weak to trust
criteria.compatible: the known critical attributes were compatible

counterfactual.instructions: Is this pair a minted counterfactual twin (one attribute deliberately flipped from its source), rather than an observed pair?

same_brand_only.instructions: Do the two listings share a brand but describe different grocery items (same brand only, not the same product)?

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Does the state carry enough measured identity evidence to decide? For a pair, both sides must carry at least one measured slice field.

better_match.instructions: The state carries one anchor listing and two candidate matches. Which candidate is the better match to the anchor (same physical product)?

criteria.candidate_1: the first candidate is the better match to the anchor
criteria.candidate_2: the second candidate is the better match to the anchor
